description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). The r-def-cursor-dao PA/CH shape with storage order unlike key order: PA(ID primary key, V TEXT(10); IDs inserted 3, 1, 2 with V 'p3', 'p1', 'p2') and CH(ID primary key, PID LONG, W TEXT(10); foreign key PID to PA; rows (ID, PID) inserted (4, 1), (2, 3), (5, 1), (1, 2), (3, 3) with W 'c1' to 'c5' in insertion order). Each of SELECT * FROM PA INNER JOIN CH ON PA.ID = CH.PID; SELECT * FROM CH INNER JOIN PA ON PA.ID = CH.PID opened as a dynaset and then as a snapshot, all rows read. Asks whether a join's dynaset comes in its snapshot's order or in another (a key order of either table).
